review_notes: Cropped metadata-clean Commons/NASA Landsat time-series shows Padma River channel boundaries migrating over multiple years, with outer-bank retreat/cutbank erosion and exposed light-toned sand/bar accretion along opposite or inner banks. A single satellite frame can show a braided river planform, but the target concept requires observing bank-line retreat and bar/deposition growth across the temporal sequence. The source page double-checks the Padma River time-series context, but the pass decision relies on visible channel-boundary and bar-morphology evolution in the video. Bottom year labels, audio, and source metadata were removed.
